source_type: suite release (MedHELM/HELM CodaLab bundle of MedDialog-EN with BioBART preprocessing)
license: none stated on the bundle; MedDialog notes all copyrights of the dialogues belong to healthcaremagic.com and icliniq.com
english: yes (English MedDialog only; the Chinese MedDialog is not in this bundle)
request_fields: HELM instruction "Generate a one sentence summary of this patient-doctor conversation." + src (Patient: ... Doctor: ... dialogue)
notes: url_data in todo.csv is this CodaLab bundle, which HELM's MedDialogScenario downloads (test split only; train 200 MB + 32 MB and valid files not downloaded). The task is dialogue-to-question summarization (tgt = the patient's question title). Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: template: MedHELM med_dialog prompt (HELM generation adapter: instruction, blank line, "Patient-Doctor: <dialogue>", then the output cue "Summary:"); healthcaremagic and icliniq pooled
rendering.template_source: https://github.com/stanford-crfm/helm/blob/63754d05db6f874e41a395880fb573890a13e791/src/helm/benchmark/run_specs/medhelm_run_specs.py (get_med_dialog_spec) + src/helm/benchmark/adaptation/common_adapter_specs.py and prompt.py at the same commit
